hud_hint_keys: F8 Click-Through · F9 Hide/Show panels · Drag to Move
pace_early_note: Pre-7:30 · Early sample, use as directional guide
pace_late_note: 20:00+ · Late game, focus on live macro calls
call_smite_adv_detail: Enemy jungler down for {sec}s (no enemy Smite). Pull {objective} now.
call_smite_warn_detail: Ally jungler dead ({sec}s). Trade opposite map side or clear waves.
call_num_adv_detail: Enemy down ({enemy_dead} dead). Push towers or take {objective} before respawn.
call_num_adv_detail_towers: Enemy down ({enemy_dead} dead). Push towers before respawn.
call_num_disadv_detail: Outnumbered. Give outer objectives and clear waves safely.
call_soul_threat_detail: Enemy has {enemy_dragons} dragons. Group 45s early and clear river vision.
call_soul_point_detail: One dragon left for Soul. Set up bot river control before spawn.
call_grubs_window_detail: Topside objective active ({ally_grubs} grubs). Shove top/mid before rotating.
call_baron_window_detail: Enemy jungler down or outnumbered past 20:00. Sweep pit and start Baron.
call_carry_group_detail: Ally {lane} is ahead ({kills}K). Shadow and peel instead of solo forcing.
call_recall_gold_detail: Enough gold for a spike. Shove wave and reset before next objective.
call_counter_heal_detail: Heavy enemy healing/lifesteal detected. Grab an 800G Grievous component.
call_counter_tank_detail: Enemy stacking armor/HP. Plan percentage penetration as next core.
call_even_farm_detail: Game is close. Maintain CS lead and ward river before 14:00 plates fall.
briefing_cause_none: Nothing is clearly putting you behind right now.
hud_hotkeys_local_only: Global hotkeys unavailable — click the HUD first
call_aram_reset_detail: Holding heavy unspent gold. Trade a clean fight to buy items and spike.
call_aram_poke_detail: Keep health up, track key ultimates, and engage together 5v5.
hud_auto_on: Auto-start ON · HUD pops up automatically when a LoL match starts.
hud_auto_off: Tip: Click AUTO above so HUD launches automatically whenever you play LoL.
consent_body: PACE MAKER only reads Riot's official local game API on this PC. Unless you turn on the option below, no game information leaves your computer.
consent_share: Share anonymous match numbers to improve the model (optional)
consent_share_detail: Sent once after each Summoner's Rift game: a random install ID, tier range, 18 team-difference numbers at 10/15/20/25 min, and which side won. Never your name, Riot ID, champions or chat. Turn off anytime with the DATA chip (stored records are deleted).
consent_autostart: Start with my computer and pop up automatically when a match starts
consent_ready: PACE MAKER is waiting in the background. The HUD will appear when your match starts.
hud_data_on: DATA ON · anonymous match numbers are shared after each game.
hud_data_off: DATA OFF · nothing leaves this PC.
fix_kills_diff: Don't fight alone; move next to your team.
fix_assists_diff: Move with your team near where the next fight will be.
fix_cs_diff: Take minions first instead of forcing fights.
why_avg_level_diff: Your team is {n} levels lower on average.
fix_avg_level_diff: Don't leave your lane empty for long; keep the XP.
fix_dragons_diff: Get bot-side river vision 1 minute before the next dragon.
fix_heralds_diff: Push top and mid before the next top-side objective.
fix_towers_diff: Clear the wave and defend near your tower.
fix_voidgrubs_diff: Get top-side river vision before the next Voidgrubs.
fix_barons_diff: Stay grouped near Baron so nobody gets caught alone.
fix_elder_diff: Group up as five and set vision before Elder spawns.
fix_inhibitors_diff: Clear the super minions at your base first.
why_recent_3m_kill_diff: You lost the last 3 minutes of fights by {n} kills.
fix_recent_3m_kill_diff: Avoid fights for a moment, clear waves, then regroup.
why_lane_cs_diff: Top, mid and bot have {n} less CS combined.
why_impact: Without this gap your win chance would go from {now}% to {even}%.
me_below: Your {metric} is {value}, below the {mean} average for your tier.
me_above: Your {metric} is {value}, above the {mean} average for your tier.
